limits: Read-only recorder. Root explicitly executes all capture and save calls.
Actor transform is sampled in shoulder.actor_world; animated head-bone movement is separately recorded.
20Hz default sampling supports orbit invariance and control-state checks; it does not guarantee per-game-tick speed integration.
Target coordinate convention must be supplied from the implemented Blueprint; no guessed world/local conversion.
Host raw-mouse and Tab events remain separate Actions evidence; UIOnly can consume keys before PlayerController.
